public_rationale: Contemporaneous CNBC reporting agrees that OpenAI was losing money. That makes the claim plausible, but the financial scoring rules require a defined accounting basis and matching reporting period. Neither is established here. This hold is not evidence that OpenAI was profitable.
limitations: Several financial reports could not be read.
First-half results would not, by themselves, establish the second quarter's result.
The accounting-basis requirement prevents a decisive score even though contemporary reporting agrees with the statement.
